title: Indonesia: President Prabowo’s two years marred by regression of civic freedoms
content:
CIVICUS, a global civil society alliance, urges President Prabowo Subianto to halt his assault on civic freedoms and to adhere to Indonesia’s human rights obligations. Two years since he came to power – on 20 October 2024 - the situation of civic space is regressing, as highlighted in a CIVICUS brief published today.

Over the last two years, CIVICUS has documented attacks, harassment, prosecutions and surveillance targeting dozens of human rights defenders. The criminalisation and detention of eight activists on baseless charges following the August 2025 protests and the acid attack on activist Andrie Yunus in March 2026 illustrates the serious risks and dangers faced by many for undertaking their activism under this regime.

title: Arvio: Suomen historia ei olekaan sellainen kuin kuvittelimme
content:
Suomen historia alkaa ilmastonmuutoksesta, kuuluu kirjan ensimmäinen lause. Perusteellisesti mutta tiiviisti laadittu teos on suunnattu myös Suomeen muualta muuttaneille lukijoille.

Kirja kuljettaa lukijaa kivikaudelta Ruotsin ja Venäjän vallan alaisuuden kautta hyvinvointivaltiota rakentaneeseen ja nyt osin sitä purkavaan Suomeen.

Teos nostaa esiin myös uusia tulkintoja Suomen historiasta. Jo maan asuttaminen tapahtui toisin kuin pitkään on uskottu. Suomalaiset eivät saapuneet yhtenä muuttoliikkeenä yhdestä suunnasta, vaan väestö muodostui eri aikoina etelästä, lännestä ja idästä tulleista ryhmistä.

Virheellinen on myös käsitys, jonka mukaan kristinusko saapui Suomeen läntisestä naapurista kolmen ristiretken seurauksena. Todellisuudessa kyse oli useiden sukupolvien mittaisesta muutoksesta, jonka aikana uskonto juurtui vähitellen.

Perinteiset tavat ja uskomukset elivät pitkään uuden rinnalla. Historialliset muutokset eivät yleensä ole äkillisiä hyppäyksiä vaan pitkiä, vuorovaikutteisia prosesseja.

SUOMEN HISTORIA on kokonaisuutena pitkälti tasapainoilua kahden suurvallan, Ruotsin ja Venäjän, välissä.

title: Building Bridges between Bangladesh-China through Wikimedia
content:
How university life in Changsha became an opportunity to bring language, culture, and free knowledge together.

When I moved to Changsha, China to study Electrical Engineering and Automation at Changsha University of Science and Technology (CSUST), I was also thinking of a different kind of infrastructure: the infrastructure of knowledge, language and cultural representation on the internet.

As a polyglot Bengali and Sylheti-speaking student, far away from Bangladesh, the Wikimedia projects were a way to stay connected to my language and be part of a global movement for free knowledge. In 2019, that interest began to take shape beyond individual edits, through in-person gatherings that brought Bangla Wikipedia contributors and Chinese Wikimedians together. In 2020, I was featured by Changsha Evening News for my involvement in promoting cultural exchange between Bangladesh and China as a cultural ambassador.

title: Activists push for Pakistan to recognise and support people with albinism
content:
Pakistan keeps no data on people with albinism, leaving needs unmet in schools, healthcare, and jobs.

Originally published on Global Voices

Graph from the 2021 study “Genetic Causes of Oculocutaneous Albinism in Pakistani Population.” Sajid et al., Genes 2021, 12(4), 492. CC BY 4.0 via MDPI.

For Adeel Nasir, 24, who has albinism and lives in Kot Radha Kishan, a town in Kasur district, Punjab Province of Pakistan, school meant constant adjustment to challenges that many people around him did not understand.

Because of low vision, he struggled to read what was written on classroom whiteboards. Some teachers seated him closer to the board, improved the lighting, and gave him written notes. But one classroom incident remained painful.

Adeel once asked a teacher what qualifications a fighter pilot needs. He expected encouragement about his ambition. Instead, he received a response focused on his eyesight.

“First of all, you should be able to see clearly with your eyes,” Adeel recalled the teacher saying.

His classmates laughed. Years later, he says people still notice his condition before they recognise his abilities.

title: Wikipedia often gets taken for granted – but its history is fascinating, and its future is fragile
content:
Wikipedia’s 68m articles have been consulted trillions of times. Not bad for a website that has barely changed since it was founded 20 years ago

A few years ago, I was struck by the tension between how Wikipedia was used, and how it was talked about. Everyone was on it all the time, and yet its reputation had stalled at “don’t trust it”, because it was the “free encyclopedia that anyone can edit”.

Clearly people were trusting it, so much so it had become part of the fabric of everyday life since it was founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger in 2001. But despite the fact it now has been consulted trillions of times by billions of people (English Wikipedia alone is 5.2bn words long), it inspires an odd lack of curiosity. Even people donating to Wikipedia might say the money was “for the factcheckers”, though there aren’t any – not paid ones, anyway. Meanwhile, the internet in the social media era had begun to feel like a much uglier place, and some digital nostalgia was setting in: here was this holdover that had somehow survived; a website that functions – and even looks – much the same as it did 20 years ago.

title: Video game film adaptations used to be huge flops. Now studios can’t get enough
content:
In the early 1990s, when the home video game market was still in its infancy, Hollywood attempted to leverage the appeal of this emerging entertainment for feature length films.

The resulting movies – including Super Mario Bros. (1993), Mortal Kombat (1995), and the Jean Claude Van Damme-starring Street Fighter (1994) – largely bombed in their critical reception.

Today, however, video game to film adaptations are filling multiplexes, from blockbusters such as A Minecraft Movie (2025), to elevated horrors such as the recent Resident Evil (2026) film, and lower-budget breakouts like Iron Lung (2026).

As Street Fighter swing-kicks its way back into cinemas, it’s worth looking at how, and why, the video game-to-film pipeline has started gushing anew.

Film studios favour projects that will simultaneously appeal to younger and older audiences. This explains why there are so many live action Disney remakes.

The current video game film adaptation trend kicked off around 2020 – made possible by a cross-generational audience that didn’t exist a few decades ago.
snippet: In the early 1990s, when the home video game market was still in its infancy, Hollywood attempted to leverage the appeal of this emerging entertainment for feature length films.

title: Did Mendel Breed Mice?
content:
We are delighted to share a new essay from our group, published open access in . Many genetics students have heard that Mendel first studied inheritance in mice, saw the segregation of fur colour, and switched to peas only when a disapproving bishop objected to a friar watching rodents mate. It is a wonderful story, but is it true?

The paper traces the tale back to its only source, Hugo Iltis, who interviewed people who had known Mendel and reported that he kept white and grey mice in his rooms at the abbey. Iltis himself presented any crossing experiments as his own speculation. The essay sets this against the real tensions of the time, including the hostility of Bishop Schaffgotsch towards St Thomas’s Abbey, and shows that the famous remark attributed to Mendel, that the bishop did not realise plants also have sex, is a modern literary invention with no historical basis.

That Mendel kept mice is plausible, but what he did with them remains unknown. The story, the paper argues, is a fine example of how anecdotes gather around famous scientists and of the temptation to read the past through what we already know.

title: Beyond Wikipedia: Training Editors with Wikimedia Nigeria, Rivers Network
content:
When you hear Wikipedia, do you ever stop to think about the other Wikimedia projects?

That was the idea behind Beyond Wikipedia: Exploring the Wikimedia Projects, a training series organised by Wikimedia Nigeria,Rivers Network, where different trainers took participants through different Wikimedia projects, including Diff, Wikiquote, Wikiversity, Wikimedia Commons, Wikisource, and Wikipedia. I was one of the trainers, and I handled the Wikipedia session.

Nubel Bariloe, the Vice President of the Network, reached out to invite me to be one of the trainers. I was like, why not? I appreciated how he handled the invitation. He sent a formal invitation and followed up with me about the date. I would tell him I remembered. One thing I particularly appreciated was his communication. title: What are self-replicating ‘AI worms’, and why is Anthropic worried about them?
content:
The tech company says successful AI worms need more capability on less powerful devices, but current trends make that feasible by the end of the year

Warnings about what artificial intelligence might do in the future – together with alarming reports of what it has gotten up to already – are being issued so quickly that even security experts have difficulty triaging what to worry about.

Yet a report this week from Anthropic’s offensive research team grabbed attention by describing a new, practical threat, one devoid of human characteristics or apocalyptic musings. The red team, as such internal testers are called, said it created a malicious AI program that spread autonomously through internet-connected “smart” televisions and could do the same inside other ordinary devices. While machines running AI usually need a fair amount of computing power, the researchers said that their program split parts of itself among 15 televisions and was still able to function by using a bit of power from each.

title: A New Family Tree for the Nightshades
content:
We are proud to share a major new paper on the nightshade family, published open access in , the journal of the International Association for Plant Taxonomy. The study was led by Rocío Deanna, Marie Skłodowska-Curie fellow in our group, together with Richard Olmstead and an international team of Solanaceae experts.

Solanaceae comprise about 3000 species in 103 genera, among them some of the world’s most important crops. Decades of phylogenetic research have produced a confusing mix of names applied to groups at different ranks, many of them informal. To bring order to this, the team built a phylogeny of 1474 species, roughly half the family, from ten plastid and nuclear markers, and complemented it with genomic data from 97 of the 103 genera using the Angiosperms353 probe set.

title: The Living Genebanks of Mendel’s Moravia
content:
We are pleased to share a new historical paper from our group, published open access in . Genebanks are usually traced back to Nikolai Vavilov and his great seed collections of the 1920s. Yet a century earlier, in the region around Brno, a remarkable network of experimental gardens was already doing something very similar.

Known as herbaria viva, or living herbaria, these collections were established on aristocratic estates such as Lednice, in monastery gardens and in society nurseries. At Lednice, Theobald von Walberg arranged hundreds of native and foreign trees, crops and ornamentals side by side, kept seed samples as reference material and compared the yield and quality of introduced cultivars with local ones. In Brno, Jan Sedláček, Josef Zeman, Abbot Cyrill Napp and František Diebl promoted artificial pollination and hybridisation to breed new fruit and vine varieties suited to Moravian conditions.

title: A Mitogenome for the Downy Mildew That Threatens Roses and Berries
content:
We are very happy to congratulate Zoárd Kenessey on publishing the first paper of his PhD thesis in , the open access journal of the American Phytopathological Society, together with Hanna Susi.

Peronospora sparsa attacks economically important members of the rose family, including roses, Rubus hybrids, cloudberry and arctic bramble, a much loved Nordic berry. Despite its importance, genomic resources for the pathogen have remained very limited, and standard markers such as ITS often struggle to separate closely related downy mildews or detect cryptic species.

Zoárd assembled two complete mitochondrial genomes, one from arctic bramble collected at Kevo in Finnish Lapland in 2021, and one from a cloudberry specimen gathered near Petrozavodsk in 1899 and sequenced in the museums historical DNA laboratory. Remarkably, the two genomes differ by only 41 single nucleotide changes and three small indels, showing extremely low mitochondrial divergence across more than a century. These resources lay the foundation for better diagnostics, reliable discrimination among species of the Sparsa clade, and molecular surveillance of this pathogen.

title: ”Malttia kriminaalipolitiikkaan” – oikeuspsykologi uskoo ettei pelkkä rangaistusten koventaminen auta
content:
Tehokas ja inhimillinen kriminaali­politiikka voivat olla yksi ja sama asia, korostaa oikeus­psykologi Julia Korkman. Hän varoittaa päättäjiä populismin houkuttelevista suden­kuopista.

Korkman arvostelee Suomen jyrkentyvää kriminaalipolitiikkaa. Rangaistusten koventamisen sijaan hänen mielestään pitäisi suosia uusia ja uudenlaisia nuorisorikollisuutta ennaltaehkäiseviä tapoja ja rakenteita.

Jo rikoksiin syyllistyneille nuorille tulee kehittää kuntouttavia, tutkimusnäyttöön perustuvia auttamisen malleja.

Oikeusprosesseja pitäisi hänen mielestään nopeuttaa siten, että teon seuraus tulee nuorelle pian.

Rangaistuksen on oltava oikeasuhtainen. Pitkät oikeusprosessit ovat Korkmanin mielestä suurimpia oikeushoitoon liittyviä ongelmia Suomessa, erityisesti lasten ja nuorten kehitystä ajatellen.

ESIMERKIKSI VIROSSA on kehitetty ja käytetty jo kahdeksan vuoden ajan uusia toimintatapoja nuorisorikollisuuden torjumiseksi.

Käyttöön on otettu sekä nuoria tukevia että toisaalta myös velvoittavia seuraamuksia. Vakavimmissa rikostapauksissa myös nuoren vapautta voidaan rajoittaa.

Menettelytapoja vaihdellaan ja sovelletaan tapauskohtaisesti.

title: Bridges Built: EduWiki Hub and ESEAP Hub Strengthen Access to Wikimedia Education
content:
What can happen when a global education-focused community and a regional Wikimedia hub connect their existing work?

For the EduWiki Hub and the Wikimedia East, Southeast Asia and the Pacific (ESEAP) Hub, the answer has been a practical partnership focused on making Wikimedia education opportunities more accessible, visible, and relevant to communities across the ESEAP region.

The collaboration has grown around a shared principle: accessibility and inclusivity. Rather than creating a separate program, the two hubs have connected existing activities, resources, and community networks to help more people participate.

One of the most concrete areas of collaboration has been language access. Through the ESEAP Hub’s Community Translator Program, EduWiki Hub activities including Knowledge Showcases, Workshops, and the Newcomer’s Starter Kit orientation have received interpretation support, including Indonesian and Chinese interpretation.

Näitä kysymyksiä pohdittiin tällä viikolla neljän päivän ajan Kotiseutuliiton toimistossa Helsingissä, johon suomalaiset ja virolaiset museot kokoontuivat EU:n Central Baltic -ohjelman rahoittaman Comand-hankkeen ensimmäisellä yhteisellä koulutusjaksolla ja opintomatkalla.

Suomen ja Viron yhteisessä Comand-hankkeessa kehitetään pienten museoiden digitointiosaamista ja etsitään uusia tapoja esitellä paikallista kulttuuriperintöä. Mukana on neljä suomalaista ja kuusi virolaista museota.

Museoesineen digitointi voi yksinkertaisimmillaan tarkoittaa valokuvaamista. Parhaimmillaan esineestä tai kokonaisesta rakennuksesta voidaan luoda kolmiulotteinen digitaalinen malli, jota voi tarkastella eri suunnista tai hyödyntää esimerkiksi peleissä.

title: Stefan Backas är årets Frans Henrikson-pristagare
content:

– Som barn byggde jag de märkligaste uppfinningar av gamla kassettbandspelare. Intresset för tekniken öppnade dörren till ljudets och musikens värld, och där trivs jag fortfarande bäst, säger Stefan Backas som Svenska kulturfonden nu prisbelönar för hans arbete inom ljuddesign och ljudteknik.

Ljudvärlden har i över 20 år varit Stefan Backas profession och passion.

På rummet, på naturen och på människorna. Ett ljud består inte enbart av ljudvågor, utan också av den känsla och avsikt vi lägger in i det, säger Stefan Backas.

“Stefan Backas har under mer än två decennier satt sin prägel på studio- och liveinspelningar, ljuddesign för film, teater och tv samt en lång rad konstnärliga projekt. Genom sitt mångsidiga kunnande har han blivit en självklar kraft inom ljuddesign och ljudteknik.

title: Fake Linda and me: the Agatha Christie-worthy mystery of the fraudster who stole my byline
content:
How a string of bizarre events led writer Linda Geddes to don her sleuthing cap and dig into a world of shadowy impersonators

It started with an entirely ordinary interaction on LinkedIn. Someone had tagged me in a post, saying how much they’d enjoyed contributing to a New York Post article I’d written about “chronoworking”. As the author of a book about circadian rhythms, it was exactly the sort of subject I might write about. Except I’d never heard of this person, let alone interviewed them.

I clicked on the link and my stomach dropped. There, above an article about people who organise their working lives around their biological clocks, was my name: Linda Geddes.

title: The Narcissist In Chief
content:
By Alon Ben-Meir*

When a president confuses personal loyalty with public duty and self-glorification with leadership, democracy pays the price. Trump’s conduct reveals a disgusting and disturbing pattern: he put the presidency in service of his ego rather than the nation.

NEW YORK | 17 October 2026 (IDN) — The damage Trump has inflicted on this country and the world is incalculable. The irony is staggering: he emerged from the very America that led the world order after the Second World War. He has repeatedly inverted that obligation, treating public office as a platform for self-glorification, a tool for retaliation, and a means of demanding personal loyalty, at a time when the US presidency, in particular, demands judgment, restraint, and a commitment to something greater than oneself.

title: Representation, Visibility, and Contact Zones: the North America Hub at WikiConference North America 2026
content:
Last month, Wikimedians from across the continent gathered in beautiful Edmonton, Alberta for WikiConference North America (WCNA) 2026—an opportunity to share projects, learn from one another, and think collectively about what it means to build and sustain the knowledge commons. For those of us working on the Wikimedia North America Hub, it was also a wonderful chance to meet so many community members in person and listen to the extraordinary work already happening across our region.

Throughout the conference, one theme surfaced repeatedly: representation is not simply a matter of adding more information. It requires attention to whose knowledge becomes visible, who gets to participate in creating it, and what structures shape that participation.

title: COP17: Which countries have released new pledges to tackle nature loss?
content:
Some 58% of countries have met a UN call to submit new pledges on addressing nature loss – two years after the original deadline – according to Carbon Brief analysis.

Countries were asked to submit new pledges, known as national biodiversity strategies and action plans (NBSAPs), by the start of the COP16 biodiversity summit in October 2024.

After only 15% of nations met the original deadline, countries agreed at the summit to a new text that “urges” countries to release their NBSAPs “as soon as possible”.

Carbon Brief analysis shows that 113 countries have now come forward with new NBSAPs – up from 55 nations a year ago.

Countries will gather in Yerevan, Armenia, next week for COP17.

COP17 marks the halfway point of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (GBF), a landmark agreement made in 2022 to reverse nature decline by 2030.

The summit will provide the stage for the first global review of countries’ progress towards meeting the targets of the GBF.

In Montreal, Canada, in 2022, nearly every country in the world agreed to the GBF. The overall “mission” of the framework is to “halt and reverse” biodiversity loss by 2030.

title: Changing Ukraine’s President Will Change Nothing
content:
Donald Trump thinks Ukraine needs a new president. Vladimir Putin agrees, as does Elon Musk, and the point was once made by that great friend of Ukraine, the late Sen. Lindsey Graham. So, let’s imagine that, somehow, fair and free elections with no Russian interference were to be held tomorrow in Ukraine. Who would win?

According to a September 23 public opinion survey conducted by a respected polling outfit, the winner would either be Ukraine’s incumbent president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, with 23% or Gen. Valery Zaluzhny, the former commander in chief of Ukraine’s Armed Forces, with 22.9%. Former President Petro Poroshenko comes in third with 10.7%. Fourth place goes to Zelenskyy’s intelligence aide, Kyrylo Budanov, with 9.5%, while fifth goes to the far-right politician and commander of the 3rd Army Corps of the Ukrainian Ground Forces, Andrii Biletsky, with 8.7%. Other polls show similar results.

The brutal crackdown on peaceful protestors in New Delhi over the last weekend is alarming with mass detention, unlawful use of force, the targeting of journalists, human rights defenders including lawyers, and internet shutdowns, said rights groups in a statement.

Amnesty International, CIVICUS, Front Line Defenders and South Asians for Human Rights call on the Indian authorities to release everyone arbitrarily detained for the exercise of their right to freedom of peaceful assembly and ensure accountability for abuses by security forces.

On 10 October 2026, protests were called by the youth-led Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and backed by student groups calling for the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner of India, following reports that the nationwide Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls by the election commission removed around 130 million names from voter lists.

EOSC-federaatio kasvaa nyt nopeasti, ja 14 uutta noodia aloittaa toimintansa 2026, joten federoitujen noodien kokonaisverkosto nousee 28:aan.

Federaation aloituksen jälkeen EOSC-noodi Suomi on keskittynyt EOSC-federaation yhdistämiskyvykkyyksien toteuttamiseen, mukaan lukien käyttöoikeus- ja valtuutusinfrastruktuuri (AAI), palveluluettelot ja tukipalvelu. Kansallinen noodi on työskennellyt aktiivisesti suomalaisten sidosryhmien kanssa kansallisten tutkimusresurssien hyödyntämiseksi, ja osa näistä on liittynyt EOSC-tarjoamaan – tämä tuo suomalaisen tutkimuksen huippuosaamisen tutkijoiden saataville Euroopassa. Tutkimusresurssien federointi jatkuu, ja EOSC-noodi Suomi pyrkii myös kartoittamaan, mitkä eurooppalaiset resurssit ovat arvokkaimpia suomalaisille tutkijoille.

title: "Against Tech Oligarchy": Inside the Worker Resistance in the World's Most Powerful Industry
content:
Longtime tech worker organizers Clarissa Redwine and JS Tan’s new book, Against Tech Oligarchy: Worker Resistance in the World’s Most Powerful Industry, draws on the authors’ experiences at major tech companies to chronicle the rise and fall of the tech worker movement, its early victories, and the repression and slide to corporate control that followed.

“Over the course of the 2010s, what we saw was that the tech industry wasn’t quite the industry that it had promised to its workers and to the public. Rather than making the world more open, more democratic, we saw it really be the culprit of misinformation,” says Tan, who was pushed out of Microsoft after raising objections to the company’s ties to fossil fuel companies.

Silicon Valley’s slide to the right was influenced by corporate backlash to labor’s demands, explains Redwine, who was fired from Kickstarter for union organizing. She says she hopes to inspire a new generation of tech workers to organize “within these tech oligarchs’ own empires, to stand up and push back.”

title: Janne Riiheläinen: Hyvät puolueet, voisimmeko puhua Suomen turvallisuuden valinnoista?
content:
Eduskuntavaalien kampanja-aika alkaa, ja nyt puolueiden olisi korkea aika keskustella – polttoaineiden hinnan sijaan tai lisäksi – myös Suomen turvallisuuden väistämättömistä valinnoista.

Päivälleen 32 vuotta sitten pidetyssä neuvoa antavassa EU-kansanäänestyksessä kyllä-kanta voitti prosenttiluvuin 57-43.

Oma muistikuvani syksyn 1994 kampanjoinnista on, että kyllä-puolella oli esillä näky eurooppalaisesta Suomesta ja vastustus rakennettiin enemmän epäilysten ja pelkojen varaan.

Itse äänestin jäsenyyttä vastaan, koska epäilykseni olivat suurempia kuin uskoni jäsenyyttä halunneiden näkyyn.

Olin väärässä. Onneksi meitä oli selvä vähemmistö.

SAMAAN AIKAAN kun Suomi sovittautui osaksi Euroopan unionia, silloinen Paavo Lipposen (sd) sinipunahallitus loi perustaa Nato-yhteistyölle.

Vuonna 2007 Matti Vanhasen (kesk) hallitus kirjasi jo hieman suorempaan, että Suomi “säilyttää mahdollisuuden hakea Naton jäsenyyttä.”

Tätä voi jo sanoa varsinaiseksi Nato-optioksi. Siis siinä mielessä, että linjasimme itsellemme vapauden hakea tai olla hakematta jäsenyyttä. 2000-luvulla kansasta vähän yli tai ali viidennes kannatti hyvin vakaasti jäsenyyttä ja runsas puolet vastusti.

title: From Usernames to People: What My First WikiConference India Taught Me
content:
A student contributor went to Kochi knowing the community through Gerrit and Phabricator. She came back wanting to build things with people.

I’ve been part of the Wikimedia community for about a year and a half. Most of that time, I knew it through a screen: Gerrit patches (code changes waiting for review), Phabricator tasks (where Wikimedia tracks its work), and a lot of refreshing the page to see if anyone had replied.

So when I landed in Kochi for WikiConference India 2026 Kochi(4–6 September), I was nervous. It was my first conference of this size. Looking back, it changed how I think about contributing.

Outside the community, I often get questions. “What do you actually do?” “What is Wikimedia?” At the conference, I could skip all that. I could mention Wikidata or a patch I was stuck on, and people just joined in.

Day 0 (3 September) was beneficial in this regard. There were introductions, an interactive session, and a celebration for the 25th anniversary of Creative Commons. By the time the main sessions started, I already felt a sense of belonging.

title: Ukraine disrupts Russian bot networks? The Yandex attacks and disinformation
content:
Charts showing a dramatic drop in Russian bot activity caused a stir on social media. Some suggested that Ukrainian drone strikes had crippled Russia’s propaganda machine, knocking fake accounts used to spread disinformation offline.

But the data tells a different story. The volume of Russian propaganda posts did not decline. Instead, there was a sharp drop in activity by so-called web crawlers – automated programs that scan websites and collect information about their content. That disruption may have affected the reach of propaganda online. But how? Let’s take a closer look.

In recent days, Ukraine has launched a series of strikes against Russian data centres operated by Yandex. On 8 October, drones hit a facility in Sasovo, in Russia’s Ryazan region. Further strikes followed on 9 and 11 October, bringing the total to three attacks on this type of infrastructure.

Yandex is often called Russia’s answer to Google. Alongside its search engine, the company provides email, cloud computing and a range of other digital services.

title: In Memoriam: Barry Steinhardt
content:
Barry Steinhardt, a lifelong privacy champion and an early leader in the battle for digital civil liberties who served as EFF’s president in 1998-99, died last week at age 73. 

A Connecticut native, Steinhardt led the Vermont and Pennsylvania affiliates of the American Civil Liberties Union before becoming associate director of the national ACLU. There, he helped spearhead the fight to overturn much of the Communications Decency Act, resulting in the U.S. Supreme Court’s landmark Reno v. ACLU ruling in 1997. 

When the internet was still young, Steinhardt became one of the first attorneys to specialize in the intersection of technology and privacy. In early 1998 he took a leave of absence from the ACLU to become EFF’s president, and then returned to the ACLU in 1999. 

In 2002 he founded the ACLU’s Program on Technology and Liberty. After retiring from the ACLU, he continued on as a senior advisor to London-based Privacy International.

title: Etlan vieraskirja kokosi juhlavieraiden mietteitä Etlasta ja tutkitun tiedon merkityksestä
content:
Etlan sosiaalisen median kanavilla on syyskuun ajan pyörinyt Etla80-vieraskirja. Juhlavuoden erikoissisällöissä on esitetty juhlaseminaarin vieraiden haastatteluja, joissa vieraat ovat jakaneet ajatuksiaan Etlasta sekä tutkitun tiedon merkityksestä. 10-osaisen sarjan jaksot ovat nähtävillä nyt myös verkkosivuilla.

Etla on juhlavuonnaan julkaissut erikoissisältöjä sosiaalisen median kanavillaan ja niistä yksi on ollut Etlan vieraskirja. Jaksoja on julkaistu niin X:ssä, LinkedIn:ssä, Instagramissa kuin Youtubessa. Jaksot ovat nyt kootusti katsottavissa myös tämän uutisen yhteydessä.

Haastattelut on tehnyt (ensimmäistä osaa lukuun ottamatta) toimittaja Jari Korkki ja kuvannut Joni Juutilainen.

title: Festivalvisning med besök: Nightborn
content:
Datum: fredag 23 oktober
Tid: kl. 16.45
Plats: Kulturhuset Klarabiografen, Stockholm
Biljetter: Från 145 kr via Monsters of Films hemsidor

Nightborn får sin svenska festivalpremiär på genrefestivalen Monsters of Film i Stockholm den 23 oktober. Visningen ordnas på Klarabiografen och gästas av filmens klippare Jussi Rautaniemi.

Saga och hennes brittiske man Jon flyttar till hennes nedgångna familjegård djupt inne i de finska skogarna för att bilda familj. Men det barn som föds är ingen vanlig bebis – gradvis börjar Saga fyllas av en skrämmande känsla av att det är något märkligt med det krävande barnet. Det är en hårig, blodsugande varelse som förstör deras äktenskap och deras liv. Postpartum-depression i form av ren body horror.

Hanna Bergholm följer upp succén Ruva med en ännu mer extrem och gory berättelse om föräldraskapets mörka sidor. Seidi Haarla är fenomenal, och Rupert Grint gör en av sina mest intressanta roller på länge.

Filmen tävlade om Guldbjörnen på Berlinale 2026.

Mörk, blodig och med en svart humor som sitter där den ska.

title: How an extremist network articulated a hoax linking Brazil’s President Lula to child abuse on X
content:
Monitoring of 1,819 posts showed far-right users tried to manipulate Grok, X’s AI tool

Originally published on Global Voices

Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Art by: Méuri Elle/Aos Fatos, used with permission.

This article was originally published on the fact-checking agency Aos Fatos website, on September 30, 2026. It is part of the joint initiative Laboratório de Investigação Eleitoral (Investigative Electoral Lab) with Agência Pública, Amado Mundo and Núcleo Jornalismo. An edited version is republished here under a partnership agreement between Global Voices and Pública.

A few days before the first round of the 2026 general elections in Brazil on October 4, it took only a few hours for a line said by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva about preventive exams for prostate cancer to be twisted into a pedophilia accusation against him. Aos Fatos obtained and checked 1,819 posts on X (formerly Twitter), which reconstructed how this hoax was planted and harvested by Bolsonarista users on social media between September 28 and 29.

title: Make your voter guide discoverable to AI, and pitch a vibe coding demo
content:
People are asking AI chatbots about candidates in the upcoming U.S. midterm elections, and Hacks/Hackers has launched a pilot project to connect AI to voter guides produced by independent news organizations. The Voter Guide Commons gives AI platforms an MCP server to quote the guides and links back to publishers.

CalMatters and The Baltimore Banner are the latest newsrooms to join. See the guides on our new map and watch the demo to see how it works. We want to add as many guides as possible before Election Day so if you publish one, please sign up.

Our next vibe coding show and tell is Oct. 29 at noon ET (16:00 UTC). We're taking pitches for live demos of projects you built: useful, half-working, ridiculous, all fine. The U.S. midterm elections are the following week, so we're happy to see election-related projects, whether for the midterms or an election somewhere else. Pitch by noon ET on Tuesday, Oct. 27 and we'll pick the demos beforehand. If you'd rather just watch, please join us!

title: Major Cultural Heritage and Climate Change Initiative Launched in Marseille
content:
Marseille, France, 7th October 2026 — The European Partnership for Resilient Cultural Heritage (RCH), a major new initiative co-funded by the European Union, officially launched on 29 September 2026 in Marseille. The hybrid event, hosted by the Musée des civilisations de l’Europe et de la Méditerranée (MUCEM) and the Aix Marseille University (AMU), brought together more than 300 researchers, heritage professionals, policymakers and representatives of European and international organisations in person, with over 1,000 joining online. 

As climate change threatens cultural heritage worldwide through extreme weather events and rising sea levels, the launch comes at a critical time. It marks the beginning of an ambitious ten-year initiative bringing together more than 90 partners from 30 countries in Europe and beyond to strengthen research and collaboration at the intersection of cultural heritage and climate change. 

Glenn Micallef, European Commissioner for Intergenerational Fairness, Youth, Culture and Sport, welcomed the launch in a video message to attendees.

title: Baha’is in Yazd Face Widespread Raids, Interrogations, and Prison Sentences
content:
HRANA – From March to October 2026, dozens of Baha’i citizens in Yazd faced security and judicial actions, including home searches, confiscation of personal belongings, summonses for interrogation, and judicial prosecution. During this period, a gathering attended by approximately 50 people was dispersed, 18 summonses for interrogation were reported, and three citizens were sentenced to prison. Additionally, one citizen was transferred to prison to serve a sentence. During these operations, agents confiscated mobile phones and other personal belongings belonging to citizens, their guests, and family members, some of which have yet to be returned. This report examines the details of these incidents.

According to HRANA, between March 28 and October 15, 2026, security and judicial actions against Baha’i citizens in Yazd extended beyond those facing legal proceedings, affecting participants in private gatherings, guests, and family members. During this period, security agents searched numerous homes and confiscated mobile phones, electronic devices, books, photographs, and religious items associated with the Baha’i Faith. In one case, agents also seized a citizen’s private vehicle.

title: Syria: Women Barred from Defense, Security Colleges
content:
(Beirut, October 16, 2026) – Syrian authorities have imposed admissions rules that bar women from most programs at two new state universities focused on defense and security, with applications closing on October 19, 2026, Human Rights Watch said today. The discriminatory rules clearly violate Syria’s international legal obligations and are part of a concerning pattern of actions by the transitional authorities that restrict women’s role in state institutions and reinforce gender stereotypes. 

The Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research announced on September 30 that admission to programs in law, economics and management, and social sciences at the National University of Defense Sciences is reserved for men. At the Syrian University for Security Sciences, women can only apply to cybersecurity programs. Elsewhere, programs on kindergarten teaching at public universities, some midwifery programs, and the nursing schools in Damascus and Aleppo are reserved for women.

title: Will a Nobel Solve the World’s Trump Problem? The President Thinks So
content:
By Azu Ishiekwene

The writer is the Editor-In-Chief of LEADERSHIP and the author of the new book Writing for Media and Monetising It.

ABUJA, Nigeria | 16 October 2026 (IDN) — US President Donald Trump doesn’t just think a Nobel will solve the world’s Trump-inflicted problems. He believes it. He has said, quite clearly, that he deserves a Nobel Peace Prize for his extraordinary peace efforts, especially in his second term.

He claims he has ended eight wars, from the Israel-Hamas War to the Israel-Iran War, the India-Pakistan War, the Thailand-Cambodia War, and the DR Congo-Rwanda War.

Can you think of anyone who has, in his words, saved millions of lives and done so much for world peace and security in the last nearly two years? And each settled war, for Trump, is the equivalent of one Nobel – eight prizes in all, yet he has been denied even one!

He’s not the only important person who thinks he has done what Napoleon could not do, and yet remains largely despised. In a meeting at the White House in January, Venezuelan opposition leader Marina Corina Machado presented Trump with her 2025 Nobel Peace Prize gold medal to right the Nobel Committee’s wrong.

title: Från Europa till världen – kulturarvsstandarder tar nästa steg
content:
Oavsett var i världen vi befinner oss kan kulturarvet dokumenteras och bevaras på ett jämförbart sätt – med hjälp av standarder. Den 22–24 september 2026 samlades representanter från ett flertal länder i Florens på ett stort plenarmöte för att diskutera arbetet inom den internationella standardiseringskommittén för bevarande av kulturarv; ISO/TC 349 Conservation of Cultural Heritage, där Riksantikvarieämbetet representerade Sveriges kommitté.

Under lång tid har europeiska experter samarbetat kring gemensamma standarder för bevarande av kulturarv. Nu växer arbetet till att bli globalt. ISO/TC 349 samlar länder från olika delar av världen för att utveckla gemensamma metoder, begrepp och arbetssätt som kan stödja kulturvårdsarbete.

För den som inte arbetar med standardisering kan det kanske låta krångligt. I grunden handlar det om att experter från olika länder och verksamheter kommer överens om gemensamma arbetssätt inom områden där de har liknande behov och utmaningar.

Sveriges kommitté i Florens representerades av Riksantikvarieämbetets Alissa Anderson och Ilse Vuijsters Hammarström på plats och digitalt av Marei Hacke och Valentina Torres Löfgren.

title: Vartijoita ja valvontakameroita
content:
Viime syksynä Yle kirjoitti omatoimikirjastojen järjestyshäiriöistä. Uutisessa mainittiin useita kuntia, joista yksi oli Joensuu.

”Juttu oli yhdestä toimipisteestämme. Nyt näyttää siltä, että tilanne siellä on rauhoittunut”, sanoo Joensuun seutukirjaston kirjastopalvelujohtaja Suvi Pirnes-Toivanen.

Hän kertoo, että Joensuun kirjastojen järjestyshäiriöt liittyvät useimmiten omatoimikirjastoihin.

Harvakseltaan ongelmia on myös sellaisissa kirjastoissa, joissa on paljon asiakkaita tai muuten levoton ympäristö. Silloin häiriöitä voi tulla huumeiden tai alkoholinkäytön takia.

Nuorten kohdalla häiriöt saattavat liittyä nuorisotilojen puutteeseen tai nykyään myös somehaasteisiin.

Helsingin keskustakirjasto Oodissa ei ole omatoimipalveluita perinteisten aukioloaikojen ulkopuolella, mutta Suomen vilkkaimmassa kirjastossa on silti järjestyshäiriöiltä.

Tilanteita hoitavat koulutetut vartijat, sillä Oodilla on sopimus vartijapalveluista Palmia Oy:n kanssa. Yleensä vartijat joutuvat tekemisiin päihderiippuvaisten tai mielenterveysongelmista kärsivien kanssa. Kirjastossa on paikalla aina kaksi vartijaa.

title: Toisiimme nojaten saa ensi-iltansa 28. lokakuuta Oulun teatterissa – Kehitysvammaisten teatterikerholaisten esitys kertoo nähdyksi ja kuulluksi tulemisesta
content:
Oulun teatterin pienellä näyttämöllä saa ensi-iltansa keskiviikkona 28. lokakuuta ainutlaatuinen teos, joka on osa Oulun teatterin moninaisuustyötä. Kyseessä on kehitysvammaisten teatterikerholaisten esitys Toisiimme nojaten, joka kertoo nähdyksi ja kuulluksi tulemisesta. Se on näytelmä jokaisen oman olemassaolon oikeuden voimistamisesta ja muistuttaa siitä, kuinka paljon toisiamme tarvitsemmekaan.

– Jos joku työ on ollut ilo ja riemu, niin tämä, kertoo ohjaaja Elina Ylisuvanto tunnelmista ensi-illan lähestyessä.

Ohjaajalle työ on ollut koskettava ja ainutlaatuinen kokemus aina siitä hetkestä asti, kun erityisryhmän kerholaiset kokoontuivat ensimmäisen kerran maaliskuussa:

– En ikinä unohda sitä hetkeä, kun menin tätä 25 ihmisen ryhmää vastaan teatterin aulaan ja kuulin riemukasta kiljuntaa. Rupesin välittömästi itkemään ja nauramaan. Mikä valloittava porukka! Ja valloittavana se on totisesti säilynyt. Tuntuu erittäin merkitykselliseltä, että kerholaiset odottavat innoissaan koko viikon seuraavaa tapaamista ja sitä, että pääsevät viettämään aikaa ja tekemään teatteria yhdessä.

title: Tekijänoikeuslain muutokset: sujuvampaa teosten lisensointia, vahvempaa turvaa tekijöille
content:
Tekijänoikeuslakiin esitetään muutoksia, jotka helpottaisivat teosten käyttöluvista sopimista ja vahvistaisivat keinoja puuttua tekijänoikeuden loukkauksiin. Kuvasto kannattaa lausunnossaan esitettyjä muutoksia.

Kuvasto on lausunut hallituksen esitysluonnoksesta, joka esittää tekijänoikeuslakiin muutoksia sopimuslisenssin ja oikeuksien täytäntöönpanon osalta. Muutokset helpottaisivat teosten lisensointia eli käyttöluvista sopimista ja parantaisivat mahdollisuuksia puuttua tekijänoikeuden loukkauksiin. Kuvasto kannattaa muutoksia ja esityksen edistämistä nopeasti.

Kuvasto katsoo, että sopimuslisenssimuutokset ovat tarpeellisia. Sopimuslisenssi tarkoittaa järjestelmää, jossa tekijänoikeusjärjestöt voivat myöntää niin kutsutun laajennetun käyttöluvan niissä tilanteissa, joissa lupia on käytännössä mahdotonta hankkia jokaiselta tekijältä erikseen. Muutokset vastaisivat nykyisiin aineistojen käyttö- ja lisensointitarpeisiin sekä tukisivat teosten sujuvaa käyttöä eduskunnan Kulttuuripoliittisen selonteon tavoitteiden mukaisesti.

title: When The Present Eats The Future
content:
The Achilles heel of consumer democracies is that there is precious little constituency for the future in the present. All the feedback signals — in politics, culture and the market — are geared to short-term gratification. In each case, the incentives of the system deliver what the most influential demographic wants, and when they want it, which is now.

From fast fashion to electoral contests to quarterly earnings reports, the system is responsive to the pursuit of happiness defined by the near horizon.

The consequence of this, which Harvard sociologist Daniel Bell argued more than half a century ago in his book, “The Cultural Contradictions of Capitalism,” is that the present ends up eating the future to the detriment of the long-term sustainability of society. The recent Noema essay by Simon Curtis and Ian Klaus titled “Americans Are Losing The Long Game” is excellent on this point.

title: Romanian Institutions Bought Banned Russian Cybersecurity Software
content:
More than 80 Romanian public institutions continued to purchase cybersecurity software from a Russian-founded company after the government explicitly banned its use over national security concerns, a review of public procurement records reveals.

Following Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, Romania passed a 2022 law prohibiting public entities from acquiring cybersecurity software originating fromRussian individuals or entities. In March 2023, a government order officially blacklisted a broad range of products from Kaspersky, a Russian cybersecurity firm.

However, procurement data shows that between March 2023 and September 2026, 83 public institutions and authorities made 131 purchases of prohibited software.

In an emailed statement, Kaspersky said it “does not have any inappropriate ties to any government.” 

“Kaspersky has maintained that the claims about alleged security risks that the company’s products might have and related restrictions are based on the current geopolitical climate rather than a technical analysis of Kaspersky software security,” the company said.

title: How Vincent van Gogh’s Sister-in-Law Worked Tirelessly to Make Him Famous
content: No artist, no matter how solitary by nature, becomes a cultural phenomenon alone. That’s even true of such an isolated figure as Vincent van Gogh, whose death in obscurity at the age of 37 left open the question of who, if anyone, would vouchsafe his paintings to posterity. The support of the artist’s younger brother Theo is often given a good deal of credit for making his work possible, and not without reason. What’s somewhat less widely known is that Theo, who’d long been in poor health, died less than a year after Vincent’s suicide. The work of ensuring the latter’s legacy then fell to the former’s widow Johanna Bonger — or perhaps she understood that if she didn’t steward it, nobody else would.

title: Announcing the 2027 State of Open Source Survey
content:
The Open Source Initiative (OSI) has teamed up again with Perforce Zend and OpenLogic, as well as the Eclipse Foundation, for the 2027 State of Open Source Survey.

This annual survey, now in its sixth year, brings together perspectives from OSS developers, administrators, and IT leaders around the world. It examines what technologies organizations are deploying, where teams are investing, and what challenges they’re facing. In 2027, that includes taking a closer look at AI, with questions covering adoption, development priorities, and how organizations are responding to a rapidly evolving regulatory environment and increased scrutiny.

The 2026 State of Open Source Survey showed how firmly open source has become established within organizational technology stacks:

  • 98% of respondents said their organizations had either increased or maintained their use of open source software over the previous year, up from 96% in 2025.
  • Avoiding vendor lock-in was cited as the most common driver of adoption, particularly for European OSS users.

title: Presidentti Stubb luovutti tieteen akateemikon arvonimet
content:
Tasavallan presidentti Alexander Stubb luovutti tieteen akateemikon arvonimen kolmelle tieteentekijälle perjantaina 16. lokakuuta 2026.

Professori Maarit Karppinen, professori Martti Nissinen ja professori Seppo Ylä-Herttuala vastaanottivat arvonimen juhlatilaisuudessa Säätytalossa, Helsingissä. Karppisen ala on epäorgaaninen kemia, Nissisen teologia ja Ylä-Herttualan molekyylilääketiede.

”Aikamme suuret haasteet ovat luonteeltaan moniulotteisia. Niihin vastaaminen vaatii laaja-alaista, kansainvälistä ja monitieteistä yhteistyötä”, presidentti Stubb sanoi puheessaan.

Presidentin mukaan Suomessa on varsin hyvät olosuhteet sille, että suomalainen tieteellinen tutkimus edistää myös tieteen vastuullisuutta.

”Luonnontieteissäkään ei kyse ole vain teknisestä osaamisesta, vaan myös arvoista ja siitä, millaista ihmiskuntaa tavoittelemme”, presidentti painotti.

Tieteen akateemikon arvonimi voi olla samanaikaisesti kuudellatoista erittäin ansioituneella suomalaisella tieteenharjoittajalla. Tasavallan presidentti myöntää tieteen akateemikon arvonimet Suomen Akatemian hallituksen esityksestä.

title: “Devoid of Any Factual Basis”: Again and Again, Judges Have Dismissed Trump’s Voter Data Lawsuits
content:
Since September 2025, the Department of Justice’s Civil Rights Division has sued 30 states and the District of Columbia to demand their unredacted voter rolls. 

The rolls contain confidential information on millions of Americans and have historically been managed by states. Now these lists are a major focus of President Donald Trump’s push to take federal control over elections and prosecute alleged noncitizen voters.

To date, there have been final rulings in 26 of the DOJ lawsuits.

Four cases are yet to be decided, and one state settled. 

Of the judges randomly assigned to the 26 cases, eight were Trump appointees, four were appointed by another Republican — George W. Bush — and 14 were appointed by Democrats.

The first seven lawsuits used the same opening, citing Trump’s March 2025 executive order on election integrity to claim the Justice Department needed states’ voter rolls to check that they were following federal election laws.

content:
Tieteen vapaus on tieteen kehittymisen sekä vaikuttavien tutkimustulosten edellytys.

Demokraattinen ja kriisinkestävä yhteiskunta perustuu tutkimuksen vapauteen ja vastuullisuuteen sekä siihen, että ihmiset pääsevät tieteestä osallisiksi. Kaikilla tulee olla oikeus ja tosiasiallisia mahdollisuuksia kartuttaa tiedepääomaansa. Jotta varmistamme tutkitun tiedon vaikuttavuuden, tiedettä tulee tehdä ja julkaista myös kansalliskielillämme.

  • Tulevan hallituksen tulee turvata perustutkimuksen pitkäjänteinen rahoitus.
  • Kansalaisten tiedelukutaito tulee turvata tukemalla kansalliskielistä tiedejulkaisemista ja yleistajuista tiedeviestintää

Ne avaavat tiedettä ja sen tuloksia laajasti yhteiskunnalle ja ovat olennaisia TKI-toiminnan toteuttajia. Niissä tehtävä pitkäjänteinen työ luo perustan tieteen jatkuvuudelle ja riippumattomuudelle.

title: Festivaalinäytös ja vierailu: Yön lapsi

Aika: klo 16.45
Paikka: Kulturhuset Klarabiografen, Tukholma
Liput: Alkaen 145 kruuna Monsters of Filmin kotisivuilta

Yön lapsi saa Ruotsin festivaaliensi-iltansa Tukholmassa järjestettävällä genre-elokuvafestivaalilla Monsters of Film 23. lokakuuta. Näytös järjestetään Klarabiografenissa, ja paikalla vierailee elokuvan leikkaaja Jussi Rautaniemi.

Saga ja hänen brittiläinen miehensä Jon muuttavat Sagan rapistuneelle sukutilalle syvälle Suomen metsiin perheen perustamisen toivossa. Syntyvä lapsi ei kuitenkaan ole tavallinen vauva. Vähitellen Sagaa alkaa kalvaa pelottava tunne siitä, että vaativassa vauvassa on jotain hyvin outoa. Kyseessä on karvainen, verta imevä olento, joka tuhoaa heidän avioliittonsa ja elämänsä. Synnytyksen jälkeinen masennus puhtaan body horrorin muodossa.

Hanna Bergholm jatkaa menestyselokuvan Pahanhautojan jälkeen entistä äärimmäisemmällä ja verisemmällä kertomuksella vanhemmuuden synkistä puolista. Seidi Haarla on roolissaan ilmiömäinen, ja Rupert Grint tekee yhden kiinnostavimmista roolitöistään pitkään aikaan.

Elokuva kilpaili Kultaisesta karhusta Berlinale 2026 -elokuvajuhlilla.

title: Sverige befäster sin position – topp 4 i världen för talang och investeringar
content:
Resultatet visar en långsiktig utveckling där Sverige successivt har stärkt sin attraktionskraft för kompetens, företag och investeringar.

– Sverige konkurrerar varje dag med andra länder om investeringar, företagsetableringar och kvalificerad kompetens. Att Sverige stärker sin position som ett attraktivt land för talang och investeringar är därför ett viktigt besked. Det bidrar till bättre förutsättningar för svenska företag att växa, skapa jobb och konkurrera på den globala marknaden, säger utrikeshandelsminister Benjamin Dousa.

Anholt Nation Brands Index är en av världens mest etablerade undersökningar av hur länder uppfattas internationellt. Mätningen bygger på intervjuer med allmänheten i 20 länder och fångar bland annat synen på länders attraktionskraft för arbete, studier, företagande och investeringar.

Sverige rankas bland de främsta länderna i världen när det gäller jämlikhet, livskvalitet, goda möjligheter att arbeta och bo, en välutbildad befolkning och attraktiva villkor för investeringar.

title: EU faces growing pressure to plug Ukraine’s Starlink gap
content:
BRUSSELS — The European Union is under pressure to keep Ukrainian troops fully online after Elon Musk’s Starlink was restricted amid volatile U.S. support for Kyiv.

“It was a very dangerous and unpleasant surprise,” Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told reporters after EU leaders met in Brussels, referring to Starlink speed limitations experienced by military troops in recent days. “We were using Starlink to intercept jet-powered Shaheds [combat drones] that are attacking our civilian infrastructure and killing our families … When the speed limits were lowered, we became incapable of shooting [them] down.”

Ukraine has long relied critically on Musk’s satellite constellation for wartime efforts. Reuters reported Friday that the order to slow Ukraine’s military-grade Starshield service came from the White House, days after Washington pressed Kyiv to halt strikes on Russian refineries, amid soaring energy prices and ahead of November’s midterm elections.

title: Penguin Colony review – an Antarctic odyssey of Nazis and Lovecraftian horrors
content:
PC; Origame Digital
This odd but absorbing adventure sends you waddling across Antarctica in search of an eldritch entity – uncovering a world far stranger than it first appears

A Nazi kneels down on frozen snow, staring at an endless Antarctic horizon. Another holds a gun to his head, ready to end his own life. I direct a small waddling penguin up to them, trying to imagine what it could be thinking. Dismay, perhaps. Likely bewilderment. But then a faint smile seems to break out across its beaky face, as if amused by these silly humans and their misguided belief that they could ever best this howling, harsh landscape.

title: Is it better to vaccinate against COVID and flu together, or separately?
content:
As autumn sets in and temperatures fall across the northern hemisphere, vaccination campaigns are getting underway. Vaccination is not just the most effective way to prevent severe forms of infection and avoid hospital admissions – it also protects health systems, preventing them from becoming overburdened when annual case numbers reach their peak.

The viruses that cause flu and COVID are constantly evolving, meaning we gradually lose any immunity we have acquired over time. The vaccines used in each campaign are therefore specifically formulated and adapted each year, in response to the most recent variants identified by the World Health Organization’s global surveillance and monitoring networks.

Contrary to popular belief, the primary aim of vaccination programmes is not to prevent infection. Instead, they aim to reduce the severity of the disease, the risk of hospitalisation, admission to intensive care units, and deaths among those at higher risk of complications.

title: Can India’s cockroach movement reverse its democratic decline?
content:
More than 25,000 police officers were deployed across New Delhi recently to prevent demonstrations led by India’s new youth-led political movement, the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP). Government authorities had denied the CJP permission to protest on public-order grounds.

The ensuing security operation saw the authorities shut one in six metro stations in the capital, barricade dozens of central roads and cancel over 250 trains in what Indian rail officials called an “unprecedented closure”. Thousands of protesters were detained, with documented accounts of police brutality. While the epicentre is in Delhi, protests have been documented in five other major cities.

The protests underscore a paradox at the heart of Indian politics. On the one hand, they show just how far India’s democracy has declined. On the other, they offer up glimmers of the key ingredients needed for democratic renewal: widening political participation, greater opposition coordination and mobilisation around concrete demands.

title: 1150 nuoren pelaajan aineisto valmennuksen tueksi – seitsemän joukkuelajin tulokset nyt interaktiivisessa raportissa
content:
Huippupelaajaksi kehittyminen -hankkeen vuoden 2025 kyselyaineiston tulokset on julkaistu interaktiivisena raporttina. Huippu-urheilun instituutti KIHUn toteuttamaan kyselyyn vastasi yhteensä 1150 iältään 14–15-vuotiasta pelaajaa seitsemästä eri joukkuepelistä. Raportti tarjoaa lajiliitoille, valmentajille ja muille pelaajakehityksen toimijoille tietoa kehittämistyön tueksi.

Huippupelaajaksi kehittyminen -hankkeessa kerättiin vuonna 2025 kyselyaineisto 14–15-vuotiailta pelaajilta, jotka osallistuivat eri lajien maajoukkuetoiminnan ensimmäisiin pelaajakartoitustapahtumiin. Kyselyyn vastasi yhteensä 1150 pelaajaa, joista 662 oli poikia ja 488 tyttöjä. Mukana olivat jalkapallo (307 vastaajaa), jääkiekko (206), koripallo (104), käsipallo (71), lentopallo (158), pesäpallo (33) ja salibandy (271). Seitsemän lajin yhteinen aineisto tarjoaa arvokasta tietoa nuorten pelaajien taustoista ja kehityspoluista jo pelaajapolun varhaisessa vaiheessa.

title: David Harrington, the Kronos Quartet and the American Folklife Center
content:
— This is a guest post by David Harrington, the founder and artistic director of San Francisco’s Grammy Award-winning Kronos Quartet. It also appears in the September/October issue of the Library of Congress Magazine. In 2024, the Library appointed Harrington the Kluge Chair in Modern Culture and announced its acquisition of the Kronos archives. The quartet’s 1992 album “Pieces of Africa” was inducted into the National Recording Registry.

Whenever a creative project of the Kronos Quartet reveals a need for information deeply embedded in the complex world of American traditional music, the first call I make is to the American Folklife Center. The AFC, through its expert, generous, helpful staff and rich archival holdings, has demonstrated again and again what a treasure we have available to us as patrons of the Library.

title: Will Serbia’s Vote End the Vučić Era?
content:
Almost two years of protests against corruption and incompetence in Vučić’s government may have forced his hand, but calling an early election (scheduled for October 25) is a trick he has successfully used before. He is gambling on his opponents struggling to convert their support on the streets into comparable success at the ballot box.

It is the first time in Serbia’s multiparty era that the National Assembly has been dissolved at the same time as the president resigning, and as the lead candidate for his Serbian Progressive Party (SNS), Vučić aims to return as prime minister. The constitution won’t allow him to run for president a third time.

Snap parliamentary elections in Serbia have occurred so often that they are something of a national tradition. Since 1992, Serbia has held just three scheduled parliamentary elections, compared to 10 snap votes.

Such unscheduled elections have helped Vučić overcome political difficulties before, including unpopular reforms in 2016, the consequences of an opposition boycott in 2022, and protests over the government response to two mass shootings in May 2023.

title: Italia ja Espanja lopettavat maiden väliset rajatarkastukset
content:
Espanja ja Italia sopivat lopettavansa maiden väliset rajatarkastukset. Diplomaatti- ja hallinnolliset lähteet kertoivat perjantaina, että maiden pääministerit Pedro Sanchez ja Giorgia Meloni sopivat asiasta Brysselissä EU:n huippukokouksen yhteydessä.

Italialla ja Espanjalla ei ole yhteistä maarajaa, mutta lentokoneilla saapuvat matkustajat ovat viime kuukausina joutuneet passintarkastukseen, mikä ei normaalisti ole tapana, koska molemmat maat kuuluvat Schengen-alueeseen. Passintarkastusten on määrä päättyä noin viikon kuluttua ja molemmissa maissa samanaikaisesti.

Italia asetti rajoituksia Espanjasta matkustaville kesällä Ceutan siirtolaiskriisin vuoksi. Espanja vastasi rajoituksiin samalla mitalla.

Yli 70 000 siirtolaista pyrki Pohjois-Afrikan rannikolla sijaitsevaan, Espanjalle kuuluvaan Ceutaan Marokosta heinäkuun lopussa. Kaaoksessa kuoli toista sataa ihmistä.

title: Baha’i Couple Flora Samadani and Ahmad Naeimi Sentenced to Prison
content:
According to HRANA, Flora Samadani and Ahmad Jafari Naeimi, two Baha’i citizens residing in Yazd, have been sentenced to prison by Branch 1 of the city’s Revolutionary Court.

According to a verdict issued on October 12, 2026, by Branch 1 of the Yazd Revolutionary Court, Flora Samadani was sentenced to three years and one day of discretionary imprisonment on charges of “deviant propaganda activities contrary to the sacred law of Islam through the promotion of the Baha’i Faith.”

Her husband, Ahmad Jafari Naeimi, was also sentenced to six months and one day of discretionary imprisonment on charges of aiding and abetting “deviant propaganda activities contrary to the sacred law of Islam through the promotion of the Baha’i Faith.”

The sentences were issued under Article 500 bis and Articles 126 and 127 of the Islamic Penal Code.

Flora Samadani, aged approximately 57, was arrested by security forces in Yazd on May 3, 2026. After being held for approximately one week at one of the Ministry of Intelligence’s detention facilities in Yazd, she was transferred to Yazd Prison. She was eventually released on bail on June 20, 2026.

title: F1’s Rwanda Race Could Be Bad News for Rights
content:
Formula One’s decision this week to bring a Grand Prix to Rwanda in the early 2030s could be an important moment for Africa. The continent deserves more prominence on the global sporting calendar.

But the 10-year agreement between Formula One and Rwanda also brings significant human rights risks.

The Rwandan government’s repression means journalists and others who challenge the government’s relentlessly positive image of the country may be at risk prior to, during, and after race weekends. The Rwandan government has long targeted independent media and political opponents both within Rwandan and abroad, including through torture, unlawful military detention, enforced disappearances and extrajudicial killings.

Human Rights Watch has also documented how Rwanda’s authorities routinely round up and detain homeless people and street venders before large events. People detained in the capital Kigali are held in a large warehouse—labeled a “transit center”—until foreign visitors have left. For example, some of the city’s poorest and most marginalized people were locked up prior to an international conference in 2021.

title: Näyttelyhaku Galleria Pihattoon vuodelle 2027 on auki
content:
Lappeenrannan kaupungin näyttelytilan, Galleria Pihaton näyttelyhaku vuodelle 2027 on nyt auki. Tarjolla on yhteensä 15 näyttelyaikaa tammikuusta joulukuuhun; näyttelyajat ovat kestoltaan 2–4 viikon mittaisia.

Haku on avoinna 30.11.2026 saakka, ja Lappeenrannan kaupungin kulttuuritoimi tekee päätökset valinnoista joulukuussa.

Näyttelyiden valinnassa arvioidaan sisällön soveltuvuutta, kiinnostavuutta, toteutuksen edellytyksiä, olemassa olevia referenssejä sekä toteuttajan ammattimaisuutta. Etusijalla ovat ammattitaiteilijat.

Hae mukaan toteuttamaan Galleria Pihaton näyttelyitä 2027 omalla näyttelyideallasi tällä verkkolomakkeella.

Valittujen näyttelyiden järjestäjänä toimii hakija. Kaupunki tekee toimijan kanssa vuokrasopimuksen Galleria Pihaton tilasta kyseisen näyttelyn ajaksi. Tila on näyttelyn järjestäjälle vuokravapaa, mutta järjestäjä vastaa tilan valvonnasta Galleria Pihaton aukioloaikoina sekä näyttelyyn liittyvästä markkinoinnista ja viestinnästä ja muista sopimukseen kirjatuista vuokralaisen velvoitteista. Lappeenrannan kaupunki on tilanvuokraaja eikä sillä ole roolia itse näyttelyn järjestämisessä.

title: Scammers in Timor-Leste Go Straight Back to Work After Being Busted, Police Say
content:
Foreign scammers arrested in Timor-Leste are returning to their illicit activities after being convicted in local courts and paying modest fines, police say, highlighting the challenges the tiny Southeast Asian country faces combatting a surge in cyberfraud operations. 

As an example of the problem, a spokesperson for the National Police of Timor-Leste cited the 18 foreign nationals detained last month in raids on two alleged scam centers in the country’s capital, Dili, that police announced on social media.

According to the police announcements, all arrested in those raids had previously engaged in similar criminal activities and “been processed under the law in force. Timor-Leste police spokesman Angelo Quelo told OCCRP that some of them had even been arrested and convicted twice before.

“If people commit a crime twice or third [time], then we should send them to prison,” Quelo said in an interview with OCCRP this week. 

Among the 18 suspects, 14 had been released after each paying a fine of $3,000, while the other four suspects were released after their charges were dismissed, he said.

title: In Europe’s tech capital, Irish labor unions are booming amid AI-driven layoffs
content:
DUBLIN — The Irish capital, which doubles as Europe’s de facto tech capital, hosted two very different AI summits in the past week.

Most eyes were on the International AI Summit, the signature tech event of Ireland’s six-month presidency of the Council of the EU, where top brass from the world’s biggest tech firms discussed ways to harness artificial intelligence and minimize safety risks.

But the weekend before, a very different conversation was taking place at the Workers’ AI Counter Summit, as Ireland’s tech workers demanded a say in how the burgeoning technology reshapes the workplace and society.

Ireland’s lucrative tech sector has been rattled by waves of AI-driven layoffs — and the country’s fledgling tech union has seen an exponential spike in sign-ups from workers who are worried about their future.  

There’s an “awakening” happening right now among workers in Ireland’s tech sector, and a growing “awareness that they’re not bulletproof,” said Sinéad Gibney, a social democrat lawmaker who previously worked for Google.

title: The mafia isn’t keeping fentanyl out of Europe – the lack of demand is
content:
Fentanyl and other synthetic opioids are still the single biggest driver of overdose deaths in the US. They were involved in around 38,000 of the roughly 70,000 deaths recorded in 2025, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

Europe’s figures are of a different order. In 16 countries that reported data, fentanyl and its derivatives were linked to a total of around 210 drug-induced deaths in 2024, up from about 130 in 2023. Most of that rise may involve medicines rather than illicitly made fentanyl.

Other potent synthetic opioids, notably nitazenes, have driven recent peaks in deaths in several countries. In Italy, the government’s latest report on addiction counted only five fentanyl-related deaths in 2025.

This gap has prompted a striking explanation: that Italy’s mafias, wary of a drug that kills their customers and draws police attention, have chosen to keep fentanyl out.

It is a compelling story. But it does not fit what we know about drug markets or mafias. Europe’s comparatively low fentanyl numbers are better explained by something less cinematic: there is very little demand for it.

title: Monikulttuurisuuden arjesta – nuoret kertovat omasta Suomestaan
content:
Eero Karisto

Kansallisteatterin jos meiltä kysytään -näytelmässä rakennetaan paljon. Yhteyksiä ihmisten välille, utopioita ja dystopioita. Konkreettisesti rakennetaan ja murretaan muureja ja torneja. Tehdään yhdessä. Utopiat ja dystopiat ovat esillä. Luovuttamisesta, periksiantamisesta ei näy merkkejä. Ihmisten välillä on eroja, mutta nähdään myös yhtäläisyyksiä.

Elämään liittyy pelkoja tai suojautumista. Itse kullakin on asioita, joista ei halua puhua. Yleensä ne liittyvät oman ja valtakulttuurin eroihin.

Kieli on keskeisessä roolissa. Näytelmä kuvaa kielen moninaisuutta nuorten keskuudessa ja menee tässä syvälle. Raja suomen kielen ja muiden kielten välillä hämärtyy. Monikansallisen kulttuurin myötä leviää uusia ilmaisuja, jotka yhdistävät erikielisiä nuoria ja joita heidän vanhempansa välttämättä eivät ymmärrä. Kieliraja on joskus sukupolvien välillä.

Barbie-elokuva ja Ken ovat läsnä puheissa. Niiden avulla hahmotetaan tai pikemminkin kuvataan maailmaa. Näytelmässä muistutetaan myös, että maahanmuuttajataustaiset eivät ole ainoa vähemmistöryhmä Suomessa.

title: Häkkänen: Turvallisuutta uhkaaviin kiinteistökauppoihin tulee voida puuttua myös Ahvenanmaalla
content:
Hallitus ehdottaa turvalunastuslain ulottamista Ahvenanmaalle. Esityksen myötä Ahvenanmaan alueella voitaisiin torjua kiinteistökaupat, joiden katsotaan uhkaavan kansallista turvallisuutta.

title: Growing Active Technical Contributors in ESEAP
content:
This article is a reflection on the author’s time in Wikimedia Indonesia from 2023-2026.

I joined Wikimedia Indonesia (WMID) in September 2023, during a transitional period. I was assigned to lead Wikidata programs in Indonesia, working with the Wikidata Indonesia Community. The learning curve was steep, but I was fascinated by how Wikidata describes real-world concepts, connects them, and the potential it holds.

Over time I met people from many backgrounds: academics, GLAM workers, activists, researchers working with data, students, and community members, and observed how they interacted with Wikidata. I saw a pattern: Wikidata is easier for people who already work with data, especially in computer-related fields.

title: Iraqi National Executed on Espionage Charges at Lakan Prison in Rasht
content:
According to HRANA, citing Iran Human Rights Organization, the death sentence of Ayoub Mohammad Nabil was carried out at Lakan Prison in Rasht on the morning of Sunday, October 11, 2026.

According to the report, he had previously been sentenced to death by Branch 1 of the Rasht Revolutionary Court on charges of spying for Saudi Arabia.

The report states that Ayoub Mohammad Nabil, 28, a native of Haditha, Iraq, was arrested by Ministry of Intelligence agents in Fuman County on August 26, 2025. Before his arrest, he had been working as a caretaker at a private villa and had entered Iran legally with a passport.

According to the report, following his arrest, he was held for approximately five months at the Ministry of Intelligence’s detention facility in Rasht, where he was subjected to severe psychological torture. He denied all allegations of having ties to or cooperating with Saudi Arabia or groups affiliated with it, maintaining that the accusations stemmed from his religious beliefs and activities.

As of the time of this report, the execution had not been officially announced by prison authorities or other relevant government bodies.

title: A 23-Year-Old Kazakh Owns Two New State-Backed Universities. He’s the President’s Great-Nephew.
content:
Declaring 2026 the “year of artificial intelligence,” Kazakhstan’s president is in the midst of an ambitious drive to transform the Central Asian nation into a “digital state,” with AI at the center of the effort.

Two weeks after creating a Ministry of Artificial Intelligence in September 2025, President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev announced the next prong of his government’s agenda: setting up an AI research university, which would be granted “special status.” 

That initiative is now in full swing. And the company tapped to spearhead the project was founded by Tokayev’s 23-year-old great-nephew, before a state institution acquired shares in the venture, an investigation by Radio Azattyq has found.

Qazaq AI Research University, which opened its doors to students last month, is one of two universities that were founded by Nurassyl Medeu, the grandson of Tokayev’s sister, and now have significant state support, company filings and open-source records show.

title: Tieteen vapaus on heikentynyt Suomessa – eduskuntavaaleissa valitaan suunta
content:
Suomen asema tieteen vapauden kärkimaana on heikentynyt. Tutkijoiden työhön kohdistuu aiempaa enemmän häirintää, ja tutkimuksen poliittinen ja taloudellinen ohjaus on vahvistunut. Samaan aikaan ekologinen kriisi ja muut turvallisuusuhat, huoli taloudesta ja disinformaatio kasvattavat riippumattoman tutkitun tiedon tarvetta.

Kevään 2027 eduskuntavaaleissa valitaan päättäjät, jotka ratkaisevat myös sen, millaiset edellytykset Suomessa annetaan uuden tiedon syntymiselle. Äänestäjät voivat vaatia ehdokkailta selkeitä vastauksia: miten he puolustavat tieteen ja tutkijoiden vapautta, turvaavat tutkimuksen pitkäjänteisen rahoituksen ja vahvistavat tutkitun tiedon asemaa päätöksenteossa?

Joukko tiedekentän keskeisiä toimijoita tuo nämä kysymykset vaalikeskusteluun syksyllä 2026 alkavalla Vapaa tiede ratkaisee -kampanjalla.

Kampanja tuo esiin sen, kuinka tärkeää tieteen vapaudesta ja resursseista huolehtiminen on monikriisin keskellä.

Tulevalla vaalikaudella on tehtävä selkeä valinta: panostetaanko vapaaseen tieteeseen vai tingitäänkö toivosta.

title: Prime’s Carrie miniseries expands Stephen King’s story – but weakens its central horror
content:
Warning: this article contains spoilers for those not familiar with the plot of Stephen King’s Carrie.

Amazon Prime’s Carrie is the fourth screen adaptation of Stephen King’s debut novel. Developed by frequent King collaborator Mike Flanagan (who also directed Gerald’s Game, Doctor Sleep and The Life of Chuck), this eight-episode miniseries follows the legacy of Brian De Palma’s classic 1976 film starring Sissy Spacek.

Published in 1974, King’s original book tells the story of the infamous “black prom” through a tense, tight mix of prose, fake news reports and eyewitness interviews.

Bullied teenager Carrie White, who lives alone with her religious zealot mother in a quiet Maine town, discovers that she has supernatural, telekinetic powers (the ability to manipulate matter with her mind). After being invited to the senior prom by high school heartthrob Tommy Ross, she finally has a chance to escape her mother’s influence and find acceptance among her peers. But when events at prom take a dramatic, horrific turn, Carrie’s powers are finally unleashed.

title: Cops Used AI Generated Photos of a Child to Lure Out a Suspected Predator
content:
This article was produced in collaboration with Court Watch, an independent outlet that unearths overlooked court records. Subscribe to them here.

Police arrested a Chicago area high school maintenance worker who attempted to meet a child for sex after investigators posed as a 15-year-old boy using AI generated images.

Christopher Thomas Mertens started talking to who he thought was a child through a dating app in September. According to an affidavit written by the department’s FBI Task Force Officer McKailey Scott, the investigation was done by the Livonia Undercover Resistance to Exploitation Unit (LURE), which identifies and prosecutes child sex offenders. Scott set up an account on the queer-focused dating app Taimi with “an AI generated image of a teenage-appearing male with the name ‘Caleb,’ and no age listed on the profile.  

Scott wrote that an unknown user messaged “Caleb,” and they moved to Whatsapp. After a few minutes of talking, the man asked Caleb for their age, and when Scott — posing as Caleb — said he was 15, the man said “Im interested” and “Im hard now.”

title: Ympäristöministeriö vaatii lisätietoja Viiankiaavalle suunnitellusta kaivoshankkeesta – lupapäätös voi venyä seuraavalle hallitukselle
content:
Ympäristöministeriö pyytää Lapin liittoa täydentämään poikkeushakemusta koskien sitä, saako Sakatin kaivoshanke poikkeusluvan toimia EU:n Natura 2000 -luonnonsuojeluverkoston alueella.

Lapin liitto on hakenut valtioneuvostolta poikkeuslupaa Sodankylän Viiankiaavalle suunnitellulle kaivoshankkeelle.

Kaivoshanketta suunnittelee brittiläisen kaivosjätin Anglo Americanin tytäryhtiö AA Sakatti Mining. Sen mukaan Sakatin monimetalliesiintymässä on esimerkiksi kuparia, nikkeliä, platinaa ja kultaa.

Kaivoshanke vaatisi muun muassa poikkeamaa Natura-suojelusta, sillä hankkeen ympäristöarvion mukaan se heikentäisi alueen luontoarvoja. AA Sakatti Mining on esittänyt korvaavia toimia, joilla se kompensoisi aiheutuneet haitat.

Ylijohtaja Tarja Haaranen ympäristöministeriöstä kertoo STT:lle, että kompensaatiosuunnitelmassa ei ole tarpeeksi tarkkaa tietoa siitä, miten haitat kompensoitaisiin.

Lisäksi ministeriö pyytää osoittamaan kaivoksen merkittävyyden erittäin tärkeän yleisen edun kannalta.

title: Two Prisoners Executed in Shirvan Prison
content:
According to HRANA, citing Iran Human Rights Organization, the death sentence of Reza Rajabian, 23, was carried out at Shirvan Prison, located in North Khorasan province, on the morning of Thursday, October 15, 2026.

An informed source told the organization that Rajabian had been arrested five years earlier on murder charges and subsequently sentenced to death. According to the source, he was just over 18 years old at the time of the murder.

The source added that two of Rajabian’s paternal cousins and another relative had been executed approximately two years earlier in connection with the same case. According to the source, a son-in-law of the family named Alireza, identified as the primary defendant in the case, remains in prison along with another defendant. Both have been sentenced to death and face the risk of imminent execution.

Execution of Naser Parvaneh on October 5

At the same prison, the death sentence of Naser Parvaneh, 28, was carried out on the morning of Monday, October 5, 2026. Iran Human Rights Organization reported the executions of both Parvaneh and Rajabian in its October 15 report.

title: Japan’s MMX mission aims to swipe soil samples from Mars’ moon Phobos
content:
A Japanese space mission is about to launch towards Mars. But it will not land on the planet itself. Instead, the Martian Moons Exploration (MMX) mission will focus on Phobos, the bigger of Mars’s two small moons.

The mission will lift off on Monday October 19 at 20:41 BST on an H3 rocket from the Tanegashima Space Center, in the south of Japan.

This will start a five-year mission, during which the spacecraft will orbit and explore Phobos, deploy a lander, touch down and collect soil and small pebbles. In a world first, these samples will be delivered to Earth for study in laboratories.

MMX is led by the Japanese Aerospace Exploration Agency (Jaxa), in collaboration with the US, France, Germany and the European Space Agency (Esa). The overall science objective is to unravel the origins of the two Martian moons, the smaller of which is called Deimos. Mission scientists also want to examine the wider evolution of Mars and its local environment in space.

We still have no clear understanding of how the red planet got its moons. These natural satellites could have been hapless asteroids that were passing by Mars when they got captured by its gravity.
